description: This Java class defines a command called DeleteFeatures for deleting features of a Thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes factory methods, JSON serialization/deserialization, and metadata for the command.

classes.name: DeleteFeatures
classes.description: An immutable command class representing a request to delete features from a specific Thing within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a DeleteFeatures command with a ThingId and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DeleteFeatures command instance from a JSON string or JSON object.
